title: Super Mario Mash-Up: Expansion Pack
description: This texture pack adds a new texture—alongside the Super Mario Mash-Up style—to the Killer Bunny and Jellie the cat, transforming them into the Super Mario character Nabbit and a calico cat from Super Mario 3D World + Bowser's Fury, respectively.
body:
![Nabbit and Calico cat!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0587fa0ed9d885ec40c28a7fdddd2c042430cbfc.png)This texture pack adds a new texture—alongside the Super Mario Mash-Up style—to the Killer Bunny and Jellie the cat, transforming them into the Super Mario character Nabbit and a calico cat from Super Mario 3D World + Bowser's Fury, respectively.
This idea of Nabbit as the killer rabbit texture was intended to replace the Killer Bunny—but couldn't be included in the original pack because it doesn't exist in Bedrock—has now been brought to life; I created its texture using the new rabbit model, so you can enjoy it and its baby variant!
As for the calico cat, it replaces the "Jellie" cat texture, which was not changed at all in the original Super Mario Mash-Up pack so i just wanted to make this Mash-Up even more completed, also this cat has a baby form!
Recommendation: For the ultimate experience, i highly recommend using this texture alongside the official Super Mario Mash-Up Pack to make this Calico cat fit seamlessly into your world. Original Textures & Inspiration: Full credits to 4J Studios for their incredible work on the original Super Mario Mash-Up Pack textures and chillyroll for porting the original package to the Java version.
Note: It is likely that this texture wasn't changed in the original Mash-Up because it is based on Jellie—a cat belonging to the YouTuber GoodTimesWithScar, who passed away a few years ago. Although the cat was already in the game prior to that, I want to clarify that I have nothing against this inclusion; in fact, I love it and find it truly charming.
(I also want to mention that this calico cat feels very familiar to me, as my grandparents once had a cat of the same breed—"I hope you're doing well up there, Mimi.")
With that said, enjoy!
